products.name: Acrylic Keychains
products.description:
These keychains feature a cute and playful mix of designs with a soft, pastel-inspired style. Each piece has a smooth, glossy finish and is attached to a sturdy silver lobster clasp for easy use on keys, bags, or backpacks.

One design showcases a scalloped pink heart with a sweet cherry illustration tied together with a bow, giving it a whimsical, dessert-like feel. Another features an adorable green frog with rosy cheeks, a pink bow, and a small daisy accent, adding a cheerful and lively touch. The third is a classic teddy bear design in warm beige tones, complete with a pink bow that gives it a cozy, comforting look.

products.name: Azure Paw Print Pen
products.description: Inscribe your thoughts with the tranquil touch of our Azure Paw Print Pen. This elegant writing instrument is graced with a charming topper featuring a turquoise paw print, a universal symbol of the love and friendship we share with our pets. Complementing the topper are two beads: a serene aqua bead reflecting the calming companionship of a loyal pet, and a pure white bead adding a classic touch, each separated by a sparkling rhinestone ring. The glossy teal barrel of the pen offers a smooth grip, making writing a pleasure. Ideal for animal lovers and those who adore the serene hues of blue, this pen is a celebration of the paw prints that dance across our hearts.

products.name: Bear Pens
products.description: Our Bear Pen Collection is a playful trio of writing instruments, each featuring an adorable bear topper that's as cute as it is captivating. The sky-blue pen showcases a cheerful bear with a serene, cloud-like hue that inspires calm and creativity. The classic white pen is paired with a golden-toned bear, offering a touch of sophistication and warmth to your writing tasks. Lastly, the soft pink pen features a sweet rose bear, perfect for adding a pop of playful femininity to your stationery. Each pen in the collection is finished with a sparkling crystal accent, adding a hint of glamour. With smooth writing capabilities, these pens are not just a whimsical addition to your desk but also a reliable tool for everyday use.

products.name: Black Pug Keychain
products.description: Unleash the charm with our Black Pug KeyChain. At the helm of this adorable accessory is a delightful black pug charm, complete with a loving expression. This cheerful pup sits atop a trio of beads: a natural wood bead brings a touch of earthiness, a black and white patterned bead adds a dash of playful sophistication, and a soft pink bead infuses a gentle pop of color. Assembled with a shiny silver-tone chain and secured with a sturdy clasp and ring, this keychain is both practical and lovable. It’s the perfect companion for any dog lover's everyday adventures, keeping keys organized or adding a cute twist to bags and zippers.

products.name: Blue Gingham daisy
products.description: Celebrate the serenity of a clear blue sky with our Blue Gingham Daisy Keychain. This charming accessory begins with a crisp white daisy charm, sporting a soft blue center that echoes a peaceful summer day. Nestled beneath is a natural wooden bead, grounding the keychain with an organic touch. The centerpiece is a bead wrapped in a blue and white gingham pattern, reminiscent of traditional country fabrics and gentle breezes through fields of flowers. A milky white bead completes the piece, bringing to mind fluffy clouds in a tranquil sky. Attached to a lustrous silver-tone chain with a dependable clasp and ring, this keychain is a breath of fresh air for your daily essentials, perfect for those who treasure the beauty of a floral meadow.

products.name: Butterfly Stainless Steel Tumbler
products.description:
This stainless steel tumbler is a sleek and durable everyday essential, designed to keep your drinks at the perfect temperature for longer. Made from high-quality stainless steel, it offers excellent insulation—keeping beverages hot or cold for hours.

Its smooth, modern finish gives it a clean and stylish look, while the sturdy construction makes it perfect for both home use and on-the-go lifestyles. Lightweight yet durable, it fits comfortably in your hand and most cup holders.

Ideal for coffee, tea, water, or iced drinks, this tumbler combines practicality with a minimalist design, making it a reliable and stylish companion for daily use.

products.name: Cartoon Canine Pen
products.description: Add a playful twist to your writing with our Cartoon Canine Pen. Perched on top is a charming cartoon-style dog, full of personality with its oversized eyes and a happy grin. A muted pink bead rests below, echoing the blush of joy that comes from playful puppy antics, while a sleek black grip adds a comfortable writing experience and a touch of sophistication to the pen’s design. The light blue barrel is the perfect canvas for this cute pup, making it a fun and functional accessory for both work and play. It's a pen that's sure to fetch compliments and smiles from fellow dog lovers and cartoon enthusiasts alike.

products.name: Corgi Pen
products.description: Jot down your thoughts with a touch of whimsy using our Corgi Pen. This pen is playfully topped with a sophisticated corgi, dressed to the nines in a tuxedo and ready to charm you with its dapper appearance. A bold black bead and a vibrant red one echo the corgi's classic coat and joyful personality, while the shimmering rhinestone detail adds a dash of sparkle akin to the twinkle in a corgi's eye. The pen's white barrel, speckled with glitter, ensures a delightful writing experience as you scribble away notes or pen letters to loved ones. It's a charming tribute to one of the most beloved and fashionable dog breeds, perfect for corgi enthusiasts and stylish scribes alike.

products.name: Daisy Claw clip
products.description: Embrace a touch of floral charm with our Daisy Claw Clips. Perfect for adding a hint of whimsy to your everyday hairstyle, these clips feature delicate daisy patterns that bring a fresh, vibrant vibe to your look. Crafted with durable materials, they offer a secure hold while still being gentle on your hair. Available in a range of charming colors, these clips are ideal for keeping your hair stylishly in place whether you're going for a casual day out or dressing up for a special occasion. Add a burst of sunshine to your hair routine with these delightful daisy claw clips!

products.name: Dalmatian Charm Pen
products.description: Note-taking is more fun with our Dalmatian Charm Pen, which features a topper with an adorable Dalmatian pup, instantly recognizable by its classic spotted coat. The cheerful character adds a splash of whimsy to your writing, while a sleek black bead below mirrors the Dalmatian's iconic spots. A crisp white bead, adorned with a sparkling rhinestone, enhances the pen’s playful yet elegant look. The pen's own gleaming white barrel provides a perfect backdrop for this spotted friend, making it an ideal gift for those who love this distinctive and energetic breed.

products.name: Dog Mum Pen
products.description: Celebrate the loving bond between a dog and her human with our Paw-fect Companion Dog Mum Pen. This pen is a tribute to proud dog moms everywhere, featuring a playful topper that spells out "DOG MOM" with a red heart and a cute paw print. The sleek black barrel of the pen creates a classic backdrop for the bright beads above: a bold red bead signifies the love for a furry friend, a white bead symbolizes the purity of that bond, and a glittering rhinestone adds a touch of everyday sparkle. Whether you're making a grocery list or penning a note to a fellow dog lover, this pen is a stylish statement of affection and pride for the devoted dog mum.

products.description: Our XL Scrunchies come in two stunning variations: the neutral and the black spot, each exuding its own unique charm. The neutral spot scrunchie boasts a soft, creamy fabric dotted with delicate, cocoa-brown specks, reminiscent of a leopard's elegant coat. It wraps your hair in an embrace of gentle luxury, suitable for any style or occasion. Contrastingly, the black spot scrunchie offers a bolder statement with its deep, midnight-black base sprinkled with crisp, white spots, invoking the starry night sky's infinite expanse. Both crafted with an extra-large design for maximum impact, they provide ample fabric to ensure a full, rich look and an all-day hold that's as secure as it is stylish. Perfect for the fashion-forward individual who loves to add a playful twist to their ensemble.

products.name: Labrador Pen
products.description: Embrace the heartwarming devotion of a beloved pet with our Labrador Loyalty Pen. Topped with a sculpted Labrador figure, these pens are a tribute to one of the most loyal and loving breeds. The left pen boasts a bead with a blush of pink, reflecting the warm affection a Labrador offers, while the right pen is graced with a bead that carries the swirls of marble, symbolizing the breed's strong and steadfast nature. Both pens are finished with a classic white barrel, sprinkled with a dusting of shimmer, embodying the pure and sparkling joy that these dogs bring into our lives. Perfect for labrador lovers, these pens are not just tools but talismans of the bond between humans and their furry best friends.

Ideal for the trendsetter looking to bring a dash of the safari into the urban jungle, it's a chic way to keep your keys in check or give your accessories an edge.

products.name: Matte White Glass Roomspray
products.description:
This 125ml glass white room spray features a chic and modern design that adds a touch of elegance to any space. The glass bottle gives it a soft, minimal aesthetic, while the sleek gold cap adds a hint of luxury and sophistication.

Perfect for freshening up bedrooms, living spaces, or bathrooms, it delivers a fine, even mist that leaves your surroundings feeling clean and inviting. Its compact size makes it easy to display on shelves, vanities, or desks, blending seamlessly with any décor.

Stylish, practical, and beautifully simple, this room spray is a lovely everyday essential for keeping your space fresh and uplifting.

products.name: Mickey Pen
products.description: Bring some magic to your writing with our Mickey Pen. Adorned with a charming topper that pays homage to the whimsical world of cartoons, this pen is sure to inspire smiles and creativity. The topper features a sparkling character-inspired design with two rounded ears and a floral pattern, all accented with glimmering stones and set against a pearl-like backdrop for a touch of elegance. The pen itself has a sleek white barrel that provides a comfortable writing experience, perfect for jotting down dreams or drafting fairy tale endings. It’s a delightful gift for fans of all ages who love to add a little fantasy to their everyday tasks.

products.name: Mini Candle
products.description:
These mini hand poured soy wax candles are a charming and cozy addition to any space, perfect for adding a soft glow and a touch of warmth. Compact in size, they’re ideal for small areas like desks, shelves, or bedside tables, and make lovely accents for home décor.

Each candle offers a clean, gentle burn and can be lightly scented or unscented, depending on the style. Their small size makes them perfect for gifting, party favors, or creating a relaxing atmosphere without overwhelming the room. Cute, simple, and versatile, mini candles are a delightful way to bring a bit of comfort and ambiance into everyday moments.

TRIM THE WICK | Before each burn, trim the wick to 5mm to prevent soot and the wick from 'mushrooming'.
